summary: Shows publishing a collection tarball with ansible-galaxy collection publish, which assumes a configured token, triggers a Galaxy import and waits for it unless --no-wait is given.
questions: How do I upload my collection tarball to Galaxy from the terminal?
Can I publish a collection without waiting for the import to finish?
Where can I check the status of a Galaxy import?

answer_card.title: Publish a collection from the CLI
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy collection publish path/to/my_namespace-my_collection-1.0.0.tar.gz
```
Assumes your API token is in configuration. This triggers the same import as a website upload and waits for it to finish. Use `--no-wait` to return immediately and check progress on your **My Imports** page.
